pr_title: Show dataset readiness for the next run
pr_body: Closes: #25033 This adds "x of y Datasets updated" in the next run sections on the UI. This gives users an indication of how close a DAG is to a new run. On the DAGS list: When viewing a DAG:
pr_comments:
question: why capitalize dataset in `0 of 1 Datasets`?

seems that we don't need to

Do the numbers indicate on a specific dataset or it's just count?
If I have a delay in one of the dataset how can I know which one from this view?

@eladkal It's just a [count](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/25141/files#diff-62c8e300ee91e0d59f81e0ea5d30834f04db71ae74f2e155a10b51056b00b59bR200), and it's a work in progress - you can follow [the project](https://github.com/apache/airflow/projects/16) to keep track.
@eladkal yes, its just a count. One of my next tasks is to provide a user more details on the DAG page

issue_context.title: next run should show deps fulfillment e.g. 0 of 3

review_comments:
this evaluation, `dag.schedule_interval == "Dataset"` i see we do a lot here.

it's probably easier to do `if dag.schedule_on`.

could also consider adding a property like `is_dataset_triggered`?
These are DagModels, so `schedule_on` isn't an option. Might be worth looking at a property later.
